subject: Taste-Bench prompt arm gets no researcher choices
body: research/advisor.py history_text() reads <slug>/choices.jsonl, but Track S writes history_timesplit.jsonl and Track P writes seed_choices.jsonl. So for both tracks, tastebench --decider prompt (R1-X-prompt) gets no decisions, only the first 8000 chars of corpus/ in alphabetical order (about one paper's opening, front matter included), while the advisor arm's usermodel.json is fit on every pair. That makes 'R1 beats its prompt arm' in E7 (and --taste-mode prompt in the loop) an unfair comparison. Suggest history_text read the track's history file (history_timesplit.jsonl / seed_choices.jsonl) and never the held-out pairs. Your file, so not editing it.
